items.name: Cage-free egg and Norwalk precooked egg facility expansions (FY2026 capex)
items.claim: Post expects fiscal 2026 capital expenditures of $370 to $390 million, including cage-free egg facility expansion and completion of the Norwalk, Iowa precooked egg facility expansion for aggregate expenditures of $80 to $90 million.
items.source_excerpt: Post management expects fiscal year 2026 capital expenditures to range between $370-$390 million, which includes continued Foodservice investment in cage-free egg facility expansion and the completion of the Norwalk, Iowa precooked egg facility expansion for aggregate expenditures of $80-$90 million.

items.name: Michael Foods Norwalk, Iowa facility expansion ($146 million)
items.claim: Post planned a $146 million expansion adding an estimated 132,000 square feet to the 150,000-square-foot Norwalk plant, with about 186 new jobs and completion targeted for December 2024.
items.source_excerpt: The 150,000-square-foot plant, which processes eggs and precooked egg products, will add an estimated 132,000 square feet to its existing footprint. The expansion of the facility will create approximately 186 new jobs. Construction is expected to begin in July with completion targeted for December 2024, the company said. The expansion will cost the company $146 million
